_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil regime (56% of windows move ±2+) combined with the analyst's 5.3% directional transition accuracy makes HOLD the skilled base-rate call — forcing a directional guess in a compressed-coil tape with contradictory on-chain signals is how the record went 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with low conviction citing distribution risk; narrative implies forward UP toward Disbelief/Hope based on the Aug 2024 analog
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $85K with funding below 0.015% and MVRV Z-score turns positive — genuine momentum shift to Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC loses $78K with exchange netflow turning sharply positive (>70) and retail noise velocity spikes from 0 — confirms distribution into Anxiety/Panic
